title: Define the reusable workbook artifact contract
goal: Define Archivist's reusable workbook artifact family so HVA can be the first implementation without hard-coding Appendix A as a special case.
acceptance_criteria: The workbook contract distinguishes document text, workbook definition, workbook user-entered state, derived outputs, and export/print views
The contract supports schema versioning, renderer templates, workflow steps, fields, calculations, validation, review questions, and import/export behavior
The contract keeps source/compliance traceability visible through the parent document record
The contract preserves Git plus Archivist audit history expectations for approved workbook state changes
The HVA prototype can implement the contract as the first workbook
non_goals: Implementing the full HVA UI in this slice
Defining every future workbook type up front
Collapsing calculators, directories, logs, forms, and charts into the workbook family unless they need workbook behavior
validation: Confirm Appendix A artifact metadata can map onto the contract
notes: Workbook is a reusable artifact family for multi-step, stateful, exportable document-bound tools. HVA is the first proof case.
